# Getting help

- **Questions and setup help:** join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/pv52eNr6uc).
- **Common problems:** see [Troubleshooting](../README.md#troubleshooting) in the README.
- **Bugs:** open a [bug report](https://github.com/MakotoPD/ChromaFree/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) with your
  logs. The About tab has a button that opens the log folder.
- **Ideas:** open a [feature request](https://github.com/MakotoPD/ChromaFree/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Security issues:** follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md).
